camera._comment: source: webcam number (0 on the Pi; often 1 for the C922 on a PC with a built-in camera) or a video file. process_fps: pose checks per second (Pi 4 ~9).

pose._comment: MediaPipe Pose settings. min_visibility: body points less visible than this are ignored.

player._comment: stance: orthodox (left hand leads) or southpaw (right hand leads).

guard._comment: Distances in body lengths (shoulders to hips). A fist must be no lower than the mouth + *_max_below_mouth, and no further than max_side_reach sideways from the nose. drop_hold_s: down this long = a drop.

output._comment: Where the hub listens (UDP). heartbeat_interval_s: status message rate.

debug._comment: show_window needs a desktop. record_path: save the overlay video (null = off).
